releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with the #338 standalone dashboard repair wave: the Broken/Missing SID filter is now a clear three-state control, broken SID evidence detection is shared across KPI counts and filters, raw owner SID values participate in SID filtering, Access Conflicts opens a conflict-focused review view, conflict rows use business-friendly labels and actions, and conflict display now resolves item/share paths plus owner and business-unit context where the export contains enough evidence. The package also includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
